faq.answer_text: The passing score uses a scaled score model. The exact cut score is not publicly disclosed by ServiceNow and is not always set to 70% for candidates taking this accreditation.

editorial.overview: The ServiceNow Universal Request Accreditation exam is a linear assessment designed to evaluate your knowledge across exactly 18 questions utilizing multiple choice and multiple select formats. It covers Universal Request fundamentals, configuration, Agent Workspace integration, virtual agent conversations, and reporting solutions to ensure a thorough understanding across all 5 official domains.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review official ServiceNow documentation and exam guides carefully. Focus your study on Universal Request data models, guided setup for services, and dashboard overview configurations. Practice navigating Agent Workspace and virtual agent conversation workflows to ensure complete coverage of all 5 domains during your structured study sessions.
editorial.who_should_take: ServiceNow administrators, implementers, and support professionals who configure, manage, or utilize Universal Request applications within ServiceNow environments should take this accreditation exam to validate their technical expertise.
